resourceGroup.description: The API group every generated CRD lands under (4 resource kinds + a <Kind>Configuration auth kind for each).

zendeskSubdomain.description: REQUIRED (rendering fails while empty). The <subdomain> of https://<subdomain>.zendesk.com - the subdomain only, no scheme and no dots. One install targets one Zendesk account.

global.title: Global values
global.description: Helm global values (injected by the chart-inspector / when used as a subchart).

enabled.description: Ship the ESO Webhook generator + ExternalSecret that keep the bearer token Secret fresh.

clientSecretName.description: Secret with client_id and client_secret (labelled external-secrets.io/type=webhook).

tokenSecretName.description: Secret ESO writes; its access_token key is the bearer token the <Kind>Configurations reference.

expiresIn.description: Requested access-token lifetime in seconds (Zendesk allows 300 to 172800).

refreshInterval.description: How often ESO mints a new token; keep it well under expiresIn.
